about: His scale (MEM-14): about three hundred synthetic items in his style, never copied from a live store, and recall cases for direct words, paraphrase, superseded facts, two-item answers and questions nothing should answer. Every case asks for the per-sentence block, the path that fuses keywords and meaning. A case marked pending names the work it waits for; MEM-13 rows pass once the local model is present.
